article.title: Roblox Launches Build, an AI Text-to-Game Tool, in a New Zealand Public Alpha
article.summary: Roblox's new Build tool turns text prompts into playable mobile games, entering public alpha in New Zealand on July 28 with age-gated creation and publishing.
article.body_markdown:
## Overview

Roblox has begun a public alpha test of Build, a mobile tool that turns plain-language text prompts into playable games, according to [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2217106/roblox-will-offer-ai-generated-game-creation-on-mobile-later-this-year/). Select Build features, including the ability to publish games, became available to users in New Zealand starting July 28, as [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2217106/roblox-will-offer-ai-generated-game-creation-on-mobile-later-this-year/) reported.

## What We Know

Build lets anyone "turn simple text prompts into a basic game without any programming experience," according to [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/16/roblox-launches-an-ai-powered-game-creation-feature-in-its-mobile-app/), which cited the example prompt "Let's make a cozy adventure game set in a dense forest." The tool draws on "a broad set of AI models, including both open-source and proprietary Roblox models," per [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/16/roblox-launches-an-ai-powered-game-creation-feature-in-its-mobile-app/).

The feature expands game creation beyond the desktop: Build will "expand experience creation from requiring a Mac or PC to support iPhone, iPad, and Android," according to [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/07/16/roblox-adding-game-creation-feature-to-iphone-and-ipad-app/). Creators can also move a project between the mobile tool and Roblox's existing desktop software, since users can "start work in Build and enhance their creation with the broader capabilities of Studio, or launch agents from Studio and check in on progress from their mobile device," [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/07/16/roblox-adding-game-creation-feature-to-iphone-and-ipad-app/) reported.

Access during the alpha is age-gated on both ends. During alpha testing, Build is available to "age-checked users 9 and older," while published games are restricted to "age-checked users 16 and older" globally, according to [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2217106/roblox-will-offer-ai-generated-game-creation-on-mobile-later-this-year/). On pricing, "a base-level version of Build will be available at no cost to creators, with additional paid options for power users," per [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2217106/roblox-will-offer-ai-generated-game-creation-on-mobile-later-this-year/).

The launch arrives amid broader industry skepticism about AI-generated games: a Game Developers Conference survey found that 52% of game industry professionals believe generative AI negatively impacts the industry, [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/16/roblox-launches-an-ai-powered-game-creation-feature-in-its-mobile-app/) reported. Roblox addressed concerns that the tool could flood the platform with low-effort content, telling TechCrunch: "Our discovery systems are designed to highlight games with long-term retention, which doesn't include AI slop. The quality of games on the homepage isn't changing: If no one plays it — no one can find it. The goal across these new tools is to continue to accelerate creation across all experience levels," according to [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/16/roblox-launches-an-ai-powered-game-creation-feature-in-its-mobile-app/).

Beyond Build's initial release, Roblox plans to ship additional AI tools in the coming months, including "a playtesting agent," "an analytics agent," and "an experiment agent" across Build and Studio, according to [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2217106/roblox-will-offer-ai-generated-game-creation-on-mobile-later-this-year/). [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/16/roblox-launches-an-ai-powered-game-creation-feature-in-its-mobile-app/) additionally reported that Roblox is developing a scene-generation model for creating editable 3D scenes from text prompts.

## Context: Age Verification Under Scrutiny

Build's age-gated design lands as Roblox works through separate, unrelated child-safety commitments made earlier this year. In April, Roblox settled with three states over child-safety allegations: $12.2 million with Alabama, $11 million with West Virginia, and $12 million with Nevada, for a combined $35.2 million, according to [Malwarebytes Labs](https://www.malwarebytes.com/blog/news/2026/04/roblox-clamps-down-on-chats-and-age-checks-as-legal-pressure-builds). As part of a broader safety push, Roblox began running "age checks on everyone via facial age estimation or a government ID starting May 1," [Malwarebytes Labs](https://www.malwarebytes.com/blog/news/2026/04/roblox-clamps-down-on-chats-and-age-checks-as-legal-pressure-builds) reported. Build's own age gates for creating (9+) and publishing (16+) sit on top of that existing verification system.

## What We Don't Know

Roblox has not disclosed a timeline for expanding Build beyond New Zealand, nor specific pricing for the paid tier aimed at power users. Exact release dates for the planned playtesting, analytics, and experiment agents have not been announced.
